title: VIX futures & options February expiration (SOQ settlement)
source: OCC: two Cboe primaries fetched direct and parsed by this session on 2026-09-05, at this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-02-17.md leg 1), which is the sanctioned venue for the flip the seeding entry below called confirm-ready. (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (302-redirects to /markets/us/futures/market-statistics/settlement/futures/daily; HTTP 200, 536,900 bytes with curl -L) — served as an ESCAPED REACT PAYLOAD, not HTML table markup, so a naive table parse returns zero rows and must not be read as 'the contract is not listed'; unescaped and parsed into 100 symbol/expiry/price rows across the two published settlement dates, it carries `VX/G7 - 2027-02-17` at 20.4603 (2026-09-04) and 20.6496 (2026-09-03), and `VXM/G7 - 2027-02-17` at the same prices. (2) The machine-readable CSV www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) returns the same rows as `VX,VX/G7,2027-02-17,20.4603` and `VXM,VXM/G7,2027-02-17,20.4603`. Arithmetic cross-check, computed independently: 2027-02-17 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2027-03-19, March's third Friday, matching the rule that reproduces on all nine listed VX contracts once NYSE closures are applied. Two Cboe surfaces plus an arithmetic check is the standard that promoted the vix-expiration-2026-09-16 and vix-expiration-2027-03-17 siblings; OCC: is the prefix market-events-data.ts defines for exactly this ('theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard'). This entry clears it by one margin the March sibling did not have — VXM/G7 is listed on both surfaces, where VXM/H7 was absent from the page altogether. PRIOR SEEDING SOURCE, retained for audit: EST: the same settlement page fetched 2026-09-05 during the japan-cpi-2027-02-19 sweep, filed estimate purely because that lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2027-02-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), alongside opex-2027-02-19. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW expiration exactly 30 days out — here the 2027-03-19 series, which is the March quarterly triple witching (opex-2027-03-19, estimate), NOT the 2027-02-19 monthly this settlement precedes. Two consequences. (1) The February VIX contract's own reference is the March witching, so the vol complex prices that corridor a month ahead of the equity calendar's arrival at it. (2) The front VIX future into the 2027-02-19 monthly expiration is therefore the March contract (VX/H7, expiry 2027-03-17 on the same fetched page), which AM-settles five hours before the 14:00 ET FOMC decision that day (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate) — the structure the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 ledger already owns and which is not re-litigated here. Impact LOW: it widens caution about the February corridor, supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-02-17 opening auction), and licenses nothing. Unlike its March sibling this settlement does not land on a central-bank decision day; the nearest tracked decision is fomc-2027-01-27, three weeks earlier. EXTENDED at initial research (2026-09-05, docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-02-17.md): the seeding note stopped one step short of the finding that justifies a separate document. Because VX/G7's strip is 2027-02-18 -> 2027-03-19, its settlement window CONTAINS the 2027-03-17 FOMC, the 2027-03-18 BoJ and the 2027-03-19 witching — while VX/H7, settling 09:00 ET on that same FOMC morning with a strip of 2027-03-18 -> 2027-04-16, EXCLUDES the decision entirely. A VIX future's price is an expectation of its own VRO, so H7's price can never carry March-FOMC volatility: among listed VIX futures the FEBRUARY line is the March-FOMC line and the March line is not. All eleven tracked events inside that window are estimate, and the FOMC sits at day 27 of 30, so the effect is heavily diluted; the placement is structural and prevents a wrong instrument choice, it does not recommend one. Two REFUSALS were banked in the same session and neither licenses anything: the combined FOMC-window + Good-Friday-drag richness of G7 over H7 (~0.9 points predicted, ~0.48 from each mechanic) measures at a chord-excess gap of only +0.078 (09-04) / +0.151 (09-03) — right sign, roughly a tenth, and the two mechanics predict the same sign so they are not separable at n=9; and the quarterly-anchor story (G7's strip terminates on a quarterly rather than a monthly SPX series, so strike-truncation should bite later) is REFUTED outright, mean log(dte)-fit residual +0.0127 vs -0.0063 (09-04) against a group spread of -0.2369 to +0.1487. Dated evidence that nothing here is being traded at D-165: on the hawkish 2026-09-04 payrolls print VX/G7 fell MORE than any other listed contract (-0.1893, -0.92%) while cash and the front month rose.
